title: Control Props
description: Learn the controlled props pattern for flexible component APIs.
longDescription: The control props pattern allows components to work in both controlled and uncontrolled modes. When a prop is provided, the component is controlled by the parent; when not, it manages its own state internally. This pattern is essential for building reusable, flexible components.
whatYouLearn: Understand the control props pattern and the controlled vs uncontrolled distinction
Detect whether a component is in controlled or uncontrolled mode
Build dual-mode components like Toggle, Modal, and Input
Integrate control props with form libraries like React Hook Form
Design component APIs that work in both modes seamlessly
